scope: Additive Linux read-only legacy invocation wrapper; six optimization rejection paths, normal positive only godot-focus-boundary
inputs: Explicit six-fixture source hash allowlist; never copy archived results, reviews, histories, caches or symlinks
identity: Unique UUID directory outside inspected repository; caller supplies expected UUID to consumer
acceptance: exit code zero, no timeout or surviving process group
registered fixture and unchanged source pins
new structurally valid fixture-specific summary without universal PASS requirement
contained regular output files and exact hashes
legacy_preservation: Hash all six original fixture directory files before and after validation; never execute inside them
process_control: No shell; own Linux session/process group only; bounded TERM then KILL on timeout; unknown/interrupted never accepted
positive: One actual focus runner: --version and --help plus gate/naive/guarded = five Godot subprocess calls by source control flow; no extra binary version subprocess
negative: wrong expected ID or changed output/source rejected
timeout preserves partial stdout and rejects
limits: Not execution authenticity, engine provenance, crash durability, complete semantic review, all OS cancellation, or six normal-positive reruns
